controles.affirmation: Litige Smartmatic : 2,7 Mds $ reclames, plainte de fevrier 2021, requetes de jugement sommaire plaidees le 2 decembre 2025, aucun proces attendu avant fin 2026 au plus tot ; environ 800 M$ deja payes pour Dominion et une action connexe en avril 2023
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2026, Note 14 : "the lawsuit filed by Smartmatic USA Corp. and certain of its affiliates... in February 2021 seeking $2.7 billion in damages" ; "The parties argued summary judgment motions in the Smartmatic case on December 2, 2025. At this time, no trial date has been set by the court in the Smartmatic lawsuit and a trial is not expected to commence until later in 2026 at the earliest." ; Item 3 : "including the payment of approximately $800 million to settle the Dominion matter and a related lawsuit in April 2023".

controles.affirmation: 12,0 Mds $ d'engagements de pret-relais (11,0 Mds $ disponibles au 30 juin 2026) + 1,0 Md$ de pret a terme ; tresorerie de 4,2 Mds $
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2026 : "in June 2026, the Company entered into a commitment letter under which the lenders provided $12.0 billion of commitments ($11.0 billion of which is available as of June 30, 2026) to provide senior unsecured bridge loans (the 'Bridge Facility') and a term loan credit agreement under which the lenders committed to provide a $1.0 billion senior unsecured term loan facility" ; "The Company has approximately $4.2 billion of cash and cash equivalents as of June 30, 2026".
controles.correction_proposee: Aucune sur le fond. Nuance : le hook ecrit "Fox finance le rachat de Roku avec 12 Mds $ d'emprunt-relais" alors qu'il s'agit d'ENGAGEMENTS non tires au 30 juin 2026. Le corps de l'argument, lui, dit correctement "engagements de pret-relais".

controles.affirmation: Penalite de resiliation pouvant atteindre 1,2 Md$ a la charge de Fox en cas d'echec reglementaire, ou 866 M$ dans les autres cas de rupture
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2026 : "each party will be required to pay the other party a termination fee of approximately $866 million if the Merger Agreement is terminated in certain circumstances, including due to a change in the recommendation of its board of directors. In addition, FOX will be required to pay Roku a termination fee of approximately $1.2 billion if the Merger Agreement is terminated under certain circumstances related to the failure to obtain certain regulatory approvals or upon the entry of a permanent restraint..."
controles.correction_proposee: Aucune. Precision possible : les 866 M$ sont dus par chacune des deux parties selon le cas, pas uniquement par Fox.

controles.affirmation: Les actions Class A ne votent que dans des circonstances limitees ; LGC Holdco detient moins de 1% des Class A et environ 38,8% des Class B, vote et cession decides seul par un managing director nomme par Lachlan Murdoch
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2026 : "...A Common Stock are entitled to vote only in the limited circumstances set forth in the Company's Amended and Restated Certificate of Incorporation" ; "LGC Holdco beneficially owns less than one percent of the outstanding FOX Class A Common Stock and approximately 38.8% of the FOX Class B Common Stock. The voting and disposition of the shares... is, subject to certain limited exceptions, decided solely by a managing director of LGC Holdco's sole manager who is appointed, and may be replaced, by Lachlan K. Murdoch."

controles.affirmation: Resultat net attribuable 1 685 M$ FY2026 vs 2 263 M$ FY2025 (-25,6%) ; CA 17 126 vs 16 300 M$ (+5%) ; EBITDA ajuste 3 906 vs 3 624 M$ (+8%)
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2026, MD&A : "Net income attributable to Fox Corporation stockholders $1,685 $2,263 $(578) (26)%" ; Revenues 17,126 / 16,300 ; "Adjusted EBITDA 3,906 / 3,624".
controles.correction_proposee: Aucune. Incoherence de sourcage mineure : la "preuve" cite "Net income decreased $566 million or 25%" (resultat net TOTAL) alors que l'argument utilise -578 M$ (resultat net ATTRIBUABLE). Les deux chiffres existent dans le document ; harmoniser.

controles.affirmation: Perte de 761 M$ sur la variation de juste valeur de la participation Flutter, contre un gain de 449 M$ un an plus tot
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2026 : "Net (losses) gains on investments in equity securities (a) $(761) $449 $(189)" ; note (a) : "Net (losses) gains on investments in equity securities includes the (losses) gains related to the change in fair value of the Company's investment in Flutter".

controles.affirmation: Hook : la perte de 761 M$ porte sur "un simple placement financier SANS LIEN AVEC SES ACTIVITES"
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2026 : "The Company holds an equity interest in Flutter... The Company owns approximately 4.3 million ordinary shares, which represents approximately 2.5% of Flutter as of June 30, 2026. In addition, FOX Sports holds a 10-year call option expiring in December 2030 to acquire an 18.6% equity interest in Flutter's majority-owned subsidiary, FanDuel... As of June 30, 2026, the option exercise price is approximately $4.7 billion."
controles.correction_proposee: Supprimer "sans lien avec ses activites". Flutter detient FanDuel, sur lequel FOX Sports detient une option d'achat de 18,6% : la participation est adossee au pole Sports du groupe. Formulation correcte : "une perte de 761 M$ sur une participation financiere cotee, non operationnelle".

controles.affirmation: Cable Network Programming pese 43% du chiffre d'affaires en FY2026 et FY2025 ; la societe reconnait le declin de l'audience lineaire
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2026 : "Cable Network Programming (43% of the Company's revenues in fiscal 2026 and 2025)" ; "As linear television viewership declines across the industry, 'appointment-based' programming that is the FOX hallmark remains resilient."

controles.affirmation: "Fox News reste la premiere chaine d'info cablee du pays depuis 24 ans consecutifs"
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2026 : "For over 24 consecutive years, FOX News has been the top-rated national cable news channel in Monday to Friday primetime viewing, according to The Nielsen Company".
controles.correction_proposee: Retablir le perimetre de mesure : "premiere chaine d'info cablee nationale en audience de prime time du lundi au vendredi depuis plus de 24 ans consecutifs (source Nielsen)". Le classement n'est pas un classement toutes tranches horaires.
